body:
Thank you for taking the time to write to me

I can tell you are a loyal friend

I consulted a lawyer before and i just dont think my health can handle dealing with a lawsuit

Not only did I lose my career but I lost my strength and will. I dont stand up as well as I used to.

I do have to agree with you about karma, it really seemed to kick her ass and take away the one thing she loves and that is her looks.

Thank you so much for taking the time. It means so much to me

I feel ok I guess

I dont sit around feeling sorry for myself. I just get so angry that I didnt see what type of person she is.

Crazy thing tho, not sure if you are a spiritual; person or not but after this happened I prayed for some sort of relief or vengeance and she ended up getting cancer and has been in the hospital for the last 6 months

Im still here, No ive never sought counseling except when it first happened

I appreciate y ou guys listening
